# agentic-scout

Find relevant threads and viral content ideas across social platforms.

Keywords: social,discovery,trends,reddit,viral,agentic-suite,cli,mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-scout".
- CLI: agentic-scout summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-scout mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs
